purpose: We evaluate guideline-adherent treatment of heart failure across hospitals to improve quality of care.
question: How many adults with heart failure at each hospital currently take a beta blocker?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Heart failure = a diagnosis of heart failure.
Beta blocker = an active beta blocker prescription on 31 December 2025.
Report per hospital: adults with heart failure, those with an active beta blocker, and the percentage, one decimal.
